message.text: Kia ora, welcome to #name. Restarts every 4 hours. Stay off the volcanoes when they smoke.
Tip: the Interislander terminals at Wellington and Picton have boats for crossing Cook Strait.
Server rules: no cheating, exploiting or duping. Bans are permanent.
Server rules: no racism or harassment in chat or on voice. Kia pai te noho.
Server rules: no combat logging. Log out somewhere safe and wait out the timer.
Server rules: base building is allowed away from military bases, airfields and ports.
